gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Noto Sans New Tai Lue draws round, cupped letters that feel modern and unfussy. Sniglet up top is the opposite in spirit, a display face with stubby, level strokes; the sans below keeps a long paragraph moving smoothly.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo reads contemporary and see-through, its c shapes left wide enough to look through easily. Sniglet earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Noto Sans NKo Unjoined keeps its small letters wide open and approachable, a friendly sans-serif voice under Sniglet's cable-like bent lines. A longer paragraph would glide along.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ar: Approachable is the first word that comes to mind, since Noto Sans Old South Arabian lets its curves finish before turning inward. Sniglet adds constant-width, blunt-ended lines on top, giving the page a clear lead and a gentle follower.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Sniglet looks like cable bent into letters, with no swelling anywhere. Noto Sans Shavian is its loose-curved partner, and the strongest quality here is that the heading's uniform rings sit comfortably above those unknotted, rope-like curves.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ojuju: Flat, contrast-free letterforms are what define Sniglet, with terminals that stop short of curling in. Ojuju does the opposite job, bringing soft contrast to every curve and wide, barely curled s shapes, where the heading simply announces.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-overpass: Sniglet's stubby terminals stop short of curling back in, which gives its display letters a quiet, level beat. Overpass is the modern sans-serif partner, and its strongest quality is a steady, professional texture where no word mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-palanquin: Sniglet draws every letter with one constant line width, a level display voice with blunt-ended terminals. Palanquin handles the quieter work, its curved letters keeping wide, unclosed mouths that make a sans paragraph easy to move through.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-philosopher: Philosopher reads clean and professional, with curves holding plenty of daylight and gentle shifts in thickness that never turn stark. Sniglet sits beside it as a bold, uniform, commanding companion.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-pontano-sans: Pontano Sans opens its c terminals wide, giving it a contemporary, professional look beside Sniglet's round, bent-wire display letters. Its strongest quality is that quiet openness, which lets the heading's level, commanding beat stand out.
